name: Old Fashioned
description: The original cocktail — bourbon, sugar, and bitters, slowly stirred over ice.
method: Place the sugar cube in a rocks glass and saturate with bitters.
Add a splash of water and muddle until dissolved.
Fill the glass with a large ice cube, then pour in the whiskey.
Stir gently for 20-30 seconds to chill and dilute.
Express an orange peel over the top and drop it in, then garnish with a cherry.

name: Manhattan
description: A rich, stirred blend of rye whiskey and sweet vermouth with a whisper of bitters.
method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass filled with ice.
Stir for about 30 seconds until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe glass.
Garnish with a brandied cherry.

name: Whiskey Sour
description: A perfectly balanced shake of bourbon, lemon, and sugar with a silky egg-white foam.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker without ice and dry-shake for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake hard for another 15 seconds.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.
Garnish with an orange wheel and cherry.

name: Mint Julep
description: Crushed ice, bourbon, and fresh mint — the iconic sip of the Kentucky Derby.
method: Gently muddle mint leaves with simple syrup in a julep cup or rocks glass.
Pack the cup tightly with crushed ice.
Pour in the bourbon and stir until the cup frosts.
Top with more crushed ice and a generous bouquet of mint.

name: Boulevardier
description: The whiskey cousin of the Negroni — bourbon, Campari, and sweet vermouth in equal harmony.
method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until well chilled, about 30 seconds.
Strain over a large ice cube in a rocks glass.
Express orange peel oils over the top and garnish.

name: Sazerac
description: A New Orleans institution: rye whiskey, absinthe rinse, and Peychaud's bitters.
method: Chill a rocks glass, then rinse it with absinthe and discard the excess.
In a separate mixing glass, muddle the sugar cube with bitters.
Add rye and ice, then stir until chilled.
Strain into the absinthe-rinsed glass and express lemon peel over the top.

name: Paper Plane
description: A brilliant equal-parts modern classic of bourbon, Aperol, Amaro Nonino, and lemon.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard for 15 seconds until well chilled.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe glass.

name: Irish Coffee
description: Hot coffee, Irish whiskey, and brown sugar topped with a raft of softly whipped cream.
method: Warm a glass mug with hot water, then discard the water.
Add brown sugar and hot coffee, stirring to dissolve.
Stir in the Irish whiskey.
Gently float the lightly whipped cream over the back of a spoon on top.

name: Classic Martini
description: Gin and dry vermouth, stirred to icy clarity — the definition of sophistication.
method: Add gin and vermouth to a mixing glass filled with ice.
Stir for about 30 seconds until very cold.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist or olives.

name: Negroni
description: Equal parts gin, Campari, and sweet vermouth — bittersweet perfection.
method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until well chilled, about 30 seconds.
Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
Garnish with an orange slice.

name: Tom Collins
description: A tall, bubbly refresher of gin, lemon, and soda water.
method: Add gin, lemon juice, and simple syrup to a shaker with ice.
Shake well and strain into a collins glass filled with fresh ice.
Top with soda water and stir gently.
Garnish with a lemon wheel and cherry.

name: Gin Fizz
description: A frothy, effervescent classic shaken with lemon and topped with soda.
method: Dry-shake gin, lemon juice, syrup, and egg white without ice for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake hard again until very cold.
Strain into a highball glass with no ice.
Top with soda water and serve immediately.

name: French 75
description: Gin and lemon lifted by a crown of chilled Champagne.
method: Shake gin, lemon juice, and syrup with ice until cold.
Strain into a chilled champagne flute.
Top slowly with Champagne.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Bee's Knees
description: A Prohibition-era favorite balancing gin with honey and lemon.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Aviation
description: A delicately floral gin cocktail tinted violet by crème de violette.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake well until chilled.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe glass.
Garnish with a brandied cherry.

name: Gimlet
description: A crisp, tart classic of gin and lime cordial.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake well until chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe glass.
Garnish with a lime wheel.

name: Mojito
description: White rum, lime, mint, and soda — Cuba's most refreshing export.
method: Muddle mint leaves gently with sugar and lime juice in a highball glass.
Fill the glass with crushed ice.
Pour in the rum and stir well.
Top with soda water and garnish with mint and lime.

name: Daiquiri
description: Rum, lime, and sugar in perfect three-ingredient harmony.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe glass.
Garnish with a lime wheel.

name: Piña Colada
description: A blended tropical escape of rum, coconut cream, and pineapple.
method: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth and slushy.
Pour into a hurricane glass.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and cherry.

name: Dark 'n' Stormy
description: Dark rum floated over spicy ginger beer, Bermuda's signature cocktail.
method: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add ginger beer and lime juice.
Slowly float the dark rum on top.
Garnish with a lime wheel and serve with a straw.

name: Mai Tai
description: A tiki classic layering two rums with orgeat, orange curaçao, and lime.
method: Add all ingredients except the dark rum to a shaker with ice.
Shake well and pour (unstrained) into a rocks glass with crushed ice.
Float the dark rum on top.
Garnish with mint and a spent lime shell.

name: Hurricane
description: A vibrant New Orleans classic bursting with rum, passion fruit, and lime.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake well until chilled.
Strain into a hurricane glass filled with ice.
Garnish with an orange slice and cherry.

name: Caribbean Rum Punch
description: A crowd-pleasing blend of rum and tropical juices, easy to batch for a party.
method: Add all ingredients except grenadine to a shaker with ice and shake.
Strain into a hurricane or highball glass filled with ice.
Slowly pour grenadine down the side so it settles at the bottom.
Garnish with an orange wheel and cherry.

name: Margarita
description: Tequila, lime, and orange liqueur shaken over ice with a salted rim.
method: Rim a margarita glass with salt and set aside.
Add tequila, orange liqueur, and lime juice to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled.
Strain into the prepared glass over fresh ice, garnish with a lime wheel.

name: Paloma
description: Tequila and grapefruit soda over ice — Mexico's favorite everyday cocktail.
method: Salt the rim of a highball glass and fill with ice.
Add tequila and lime juice.
Top with grapefruit soda and stir gently.
Garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

name: Tequila Sunrise
description: Tequila, orange juice, and grenadine layered into a sunrise of color.
method: Fill a highball glass with ice and add tequila and orange juice.
Stir gently.
Slowly pour grenadine over the back of a spoon so it sinks and settles.
Garnish with an orange slice and cherry.

name: Mexican Mule
description: The classic Moscow Mule reimagined with tequila instead of vodka.
method: Fill a copper mule mug with ice.
Add tequila and lime juice.
Top with ginger beer and stir gently.
Garnish with a lime wheel and mint sprig.

name: Tommy's Margarita
description: A cleaner take on the margarita, swapping triple sec for agave nectar.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass filled with fresh ice.
Garnish with a lime wheel.

name: Espresso Martini
description: Vodka, coffee liqueur, and fresh espresso shaken to a velvety, crema-topped finish.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake very hard for 15-20 seconds to build a foamy crema.
Double-strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with three coffee beans on top of the foam.

name: Cosmopolitan
description: A pink, citrus-forward classic of vodka, cranberry, and lime.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled.
Double-strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Moscow Mule
description: Vodka, lime, and spicy ginger beer, traditionally served in a frosty copper mug.
method: Fill a copper mule mug with ice.
Add vodka and lime juice.
Top with ginger beer and stir gently.
Garnish with a lime wheel and mint sprig.

name: Vodka Martini
description: The Bond favorite — vodka and dry vermouth, stirred or shaken to icy clarity.
method: Add vodka and vermouth to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir (or shake, if you prefer it colder and cloudier) until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist or olives.

name: Bloody Mary
description: A savory, spiced brunch classic of vodka, tomato juice, and bold seasoning.
method: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add all ingredients and stir well to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Garnish generously with celery, olives, and a lemon wedge.

name: Sidecar
description: Cognac, orange liqueur, and lemon shaken with a sugared rim.
method: Rim a coupe glass with sugar.
Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled.
Strain into the prepared glass and garnish with an orange twist.

name: Brandy Alexander
description: A dessert in a glass — brandy, dark crème de cacao, and cream.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled and frothy.
Strain into a chilled coupe glass.
Garnish with freshly grated nutmeg.

name: French Connection
description: A dead-simple, spirit-forward sipper of cognac and amaretto over ice.
method: Fill a rocks glass with ice.
Add cognac and amaretto.
Stir gently to combine and chill.

name: Bellini
description: Prosecco and white peach purée, born in Venice at Harry's Bar.
method: Pour the peach purée into a chilled champagne flute.
Slowly top with Prosecco.
Stir once, gently, to combine.

name: Mimosa
description: The simplest brunch staple — equal parts Champagne and orange juice.
method: Pour chilled orange juice into a champagne flute.
Top slowly with Champagne.
Garnish with an orange twist, if desired.

name: Aperol Spritz
description: Italy's favorite aperitif — Aperol, Prosecco, and a splash of soda over ice.
method: Fill a large wine glass with ice.
Add Prosecco, then Aperol.
Top with a splash of soda water and stir gently.
Garnish with an orange slice.

name: Kir Royale
description: Champagne tinted deep pink with a touch of blackcurrant liqueur.
method: Pour crème de cassis into a chilled champagne flute.
Top slowly with Champagne.
Serve immediately without stirring.

name: French Blonde
description: A modern classic pairing gin, Lillet Blanc, St-Germain, and grapefruit.
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe glass.
Garnish with a grapefruit twist.

name: Virgin Mojito
description: All the mint-lime refreshment of a mojito, without the rum.
method: Muddle mint leaves gently with sugar and lime juice in a highball glass.
Fill the glass with crushed ice.
Top with soda water and stir well.
Garnish with mint and a lime wheel.

name: Shirley Temple
description: Ginger ale and grenadine — the classic kid-friendly mocktail, adored by adults too.
method: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Pour in ginger ale.
Add grenadine and let it settle, or stir gently.
Garnish with a cherry and orange slice.

name: Virgin Piña Colada
description: A creamy, blended coconut-pineapple escape, no passport (or alcohol) required.
method: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth and slushy.
Pour into a hurricane glass.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and cherry.

name: Cucumber Mint Cooler
description: A spa-worthy, crisp cooler of muddled cucumber, mint, and lime.
method: Muddle cucumber and mint with lime juice and syrup in a collins glass.
Fill the glass with ice.
Top with soda water and stir gently.
Garnish with a cucumber ribbon and mint sprig.

name: Virgin Mary
description: All the savory spice of a Bloody Mary, minus the vodka.
method: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add all ingredients and stir well.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
Garnish with celery and a lemon wedge.

name: Sparkling Cranberry Spritz
description: A festive, ruby-red spritz of cranberry, lime, and sparkling water.
method: Fill a flute or wine glass with ice, if desired.
Add cranberry juice and lime juice.
Top with sparkling water and stir gently.
Garnish with fresh cranberries and a rosemary sprig.

name: Ginger Peach Fizz
description: A bright, gingery peach cooler that drinks like a spritz without the spirits.
method: Fill a collins glass with ice.
Add peach nectar and lemon juice.
Top with ginger beer and stir gently.
Garnish with a peach slice and mint sprig.
